article.title: Western media accept Trump’s plundering of Venezuelan oil as business as usual
article.author: Ricardo Vaz
article.content: Trump is looking to secure cheap crude supplies at a time when his disastrous Iran debacle has thrown global energy markets into upheaval. The post Western media accept Trump’s plundering of Venezuelan oil as business as usual appeared first on MR Online .
